hero.paragraph1: Music, fire performance, photography, videography, and wedding ceremonies—brought together by one delightfully creative team. Lakeland Cabaret has everything you need to make any event special!
hero.imageAlt: K and Ryan of Lakeland Cabaret posing back-to-back with flaming swords

services.paragraph1: Choose one service or combine a few. We’ll shape the experience around your people, your place, and your vision.

about.paragraph1: Lakeland Cabaret is a small, multi-talented entertainment team built for people who want their celebration to feel personal.
about.paragraph2: Not sure what you need yet? That’s completely fine. Bring us the occasion, the mood, or even half an idea. We’ll help turn it into a plan that feels unmistakably yours.
about.imageAlt: Lakeland Cabaret DJ in costume at a Halloween event

facebook.label1: See what we’ve been up to
facebook.paragraph1: Catch our latest events, favorite moments, behind-the-scenes photos, and fresh ideas for making your next celebration unforgettable.

pricing.paragraph1: Every event is different. These prices are a useful starting point; contact us for a quote tailored to your date, location, and plans.
pricing.paragraph2: Holiday programming includes Valentine’s Day, St. Patrick’s Day, Independence Day, Halloween, Christmas, and more.

contact.paragraph1: Tell us what you’re celebrating and what you want it to feel like. We’ll help with the rest.
